text:
The plate is about 26 cm across, which is roughly 360 px in the image, so 1 cm is about 14 px.

The sausage is about 175 px long, or about 12 cm, and about 50 px wide, or about 3.5 cm. That is a fairly thick link, so I estimate about 80 g and 220 kcal. It could be a chicken sausage, which would be lighter.

I count about 7 roasted Brussels sprouts, some of them halved. At roughly 20 g each, that is about 140 g. With the oil they were roasted in, I estimate about 50 kcal per 100 g plus 40 kcal for the oil, so about 110 kcal.

Total: about 220 g and about 330 kcal.
